reviews.text:
WOW! Just WOW!

reviews.text:
Our pool project with Gohlke was an awful, exhausting and disappointing experience.  I would not recommend this company to anyone - especially for a higher end project.

The majority of the work was done by subcontractors. Many of the subcontractors showed a complete lack of skill to do the work correctly. Gohlke did barely any quality control or checks on the subcontractors work. I continually found problems throughout the project and had to constantly escalate issues because the Gohlke project manager did not seem to care.

Gohlke chose a contractor they never worked with before to build my pool house. The subcontractor hung the windows upside down, the doors were hung wrong and would not shut correctly, the exterior trim was warping within a month of install, and the interior trim and drywall were done incorrectly. Gohlke never checked his work even though they had never worked with him before. Gohlke continued to give the subcontractor a chance to fix his work but the contractor had no idea what he was doing. After the third attempt to fix his mistakes and still getting the work wrong, I had to ask him to leave because Gohlke would not find someone else to fix his bad work.

The operations manager from Gohlke would constantly apologize to me that Gohlke would correct the problems and that the project would be a priority for him. It was all lip service and nothing changed throughout the project. The salesperson / designer dropped off the project after the project kickoff meeting and we barely ever heard from him again even with all of the problems that were occurring.

In addition to this, I have an expensive fire pit that I need to light with a BBQ lighter because the starter is junk, cracks all over the place on the concrete pool deck, and tile work that looks like it was done by someone who does not know what they are doing. I was so burnt out and exhausted at the end of this project that I didn't even care and was unwilling to argue with them anymore.

Gohlke worked towards the milestone payments that were part of the contract. There would be a bunch of work that would occur before each milestone payment. Once we paid Gohlke, work would immediately come to a crawl with little to no activity happening for weeks afterwards. This occurred consistently with each payment. After the final payment, Gohlke's project manager disengaged from us even though there were a lot of open items left to finish the project. We stopped getting updates and I had to continually ask what was happening and remind him that an issue was still outstanding. The remaining items took months to get finished and I found it necessary to finish work myself because it was moving so slow.
reviews.author: Chris Scanlon

reviews.text:
Excellent experience with Gohlke!

Making the decision to build a pool is a huge decision and a large financial commitment.  Choosing the company to help you realize your dream is monumental.  After reading hundreds of reviews and searching for guidance on "How to choose your pool builder", most people said they received 8-10 quotes before making the decision.  I however, did a lot of research up front. I only received 2 quotes and both companies provided a dollar amount within $2K of each other.  I then requested their contractual agreements and read all of the fine print.  There were subtle differences but the contracts were also very comparable.  My choice was Gohlke and here is why.

Gohlke has History!  They have been in business for over half a century AND they still have family members in the game.
Gohlke has certifications in the pool industry, not only as a builder but also a  maintenance and repair service company.
Gohlke is a member of the Denton Chamber of Commerce - they are part of and invest in their community.  Gohlke has a 4.9 out of 5 rating with 750+ Google reviews that span time and are also up to date.  Gohlke is solid.
Now, let's talk people.
Connor Gohlke (sales/design):  This guy knows the business. He is a swimmer and grew up in the business. He exudes a quiet confidence that makes you comfortable. He knows pools, the build, the designing, the materials.  He answers questions competently, he is courteous and personable.

Matt Watson (Project Manager) :  Again, quiet confidence, and he knows pools and how to build them.  He is responsive and responsible.  He knows his crews and he communicates!  You will receive consistent updates on progress and scheduling and he is responsive to questions.  Matt did an excellent job.

Nathan Caldwell (Construction Superintendent) :  Super guy, very knowledgeable.  Only met him for the construction kick-off.  He was thorough in going over the details of the design but we didn't need him after that as Matt did an awesome job!

Construction crews:  If you are a bit nerdy like me and my husband, you will enjoy watching the progress.  Each crew performs their specialty and it is fascinating to watch!  Additionally, none of the crews were trashy.  They did a good job of picking up their messes.

We feel like our decision to go with Gohlke was absolutely the right choice!

reviews.text:
We built a pool in Collin County with Gohlke Pools in 2023.

Every person we worked with from design to the finished product was helpful, informative, professional, and a pleasure to work with. We highly recommend Gohlke if you’re considering building a pool in the DFW area.

Wes Gohlke designed our pool. Wes is very skilled and easy to work with. Every detail was discussed with us. He was so patient with us as first-time pool builders with no pool care experience. He looked out for us. There were times when he steered us toward a different or better option; he was more concerned with our happiness with the final product than making a bigger sale. The pool is exactly the classic beauty we wanted and it will still be beautiful 25 years from now because of the care Wes put into our design.

Our project manager on site was Nicholas Pisciotta. He took Wes’ design and made it a reality. Day in and day out he skillfully managed crews and subcontractors and scheduled inspections. His deep knowledge of every part of the build process was obvious and impressive. He was sometimes the person standing back, watching to make sure things went as planned. Other times, he was hands on doing whatever needed to be done. His communication was excellent. He kept us informed through every stage and quickly answered our calls or texts if he wasn’t on site. He was so calm and reassuring and helped us enjoy the building process. We could not have asked for a better person to oversee the construction of our pool.

Gohlke’s team — their own staff and the subcontractors they work with — are all the very best. Professionals who worked on our pool or in our yard were clearly well trained and carefully selected.

Critical components of our build — engineering, design, excavation, gunite, plumbing, tile and brick work, installation of stone pavers, the construction of a steel shade structure,  drainage, and the addition of a small outdoor kitchen island — were all impressive. Our city’s inspector commented to us that he had not seen such fine work in a very long time.

Even though extreme heat in August slowed work on our build, Gohlke still completed our pool in the time frame promised (under 4 months from dig to fill).

Because of our outstanding experience, we’ve already recommended Gohlke Pools many times to others considering building a pool in DFW. And we'll continue to work with Gohlke by having them maintain the chemicals in our new pool.

We’re so proud of the beautiful pool Gohlke built for us.

They accepted the job and finished the job with courtesy, professionalism and skill. They showed up when promised , fair with the quote, and were flexible with the process. This could have been a nightmare situation but they made it as easy as possible. The pool is now clean and beautiful. A team full of superstars : Josh, Travis, Daniel and Zach, Camron and Emilyn.
reviews.author: Heather Buchanan

reviews.text: I used Gohlke Crew (Even & Adrian) for one time restoration. They were knowledgeable and explained the process step by step and answered all my questions to my satisfaction.
reviews.author: Mahshid Grooms

reviews.text: Hunter is absolutely wonderful.  He works very hard, makes sure he explains what he's doing to the pool and the pool looks fantastic every time. And my dog Brutus loves him too!
reviews.author: Margaret Radcliff

reviews.text: Jason from the service department of Gohlke Pools is FANTASTIC! He is very knowledgable and did a great job troubleshooting to figure out the problem I was having with my spa. He was patient and helpful when explaining the problem. He even saved me some money which is alway nice. Kudos Jason!!!
reviews.author: Donna Taylor

reviews.text: Working with Jody at Gohlke Pools was great from the get go! He was always very responsive to my questions and explained everything along the way! Great & easy to work with! Took very good care of us!
reviews.author: Allison Dieter

reviews.text: This was my first pool build. I surveyed the list of pool builders and chose Gohlke with no regrets! Connor took me through the design phase with patience and Matt walked me through the building of it like a champ. The process went smoothly and communication was A+. These people have been in business for 65 years for a reason. They surpassed my expectations and their subcontractor Subia Landscaping was another positive. Pool build took 2 months and it truly was an easy process for me. Trust me coming from a single parent that has very little time for drama or excuses. 😅 I can’t say enough about Gohlke Pools with great service and a quality product.
reviews.author: Kimberly Erdmann

reviews.text: Absolutely the best service!!!   I needed to get a safety handrail installed in my pool.  The service techs showed up on time, were very friendly/professional, didn't make a mess and explained to us in detail about the need to let it set for 48 hours prior to using.  In the mean time, these guys provided us with free advice on how to get our pool equipment running more smoothly.  My pool has never ran so good!!!!   I will 100% be using this company for future repairs/maintenance.
reviews.author: Shawn Goering

reviews.text:
After attempting to work with several pool companies with no success I contacted Gohlke Pools.  The responded quickly and were very flexible.   Within a couple of weeks we had the final design.  Tim was a pleasure to work with and made several suggestions to make our pool look its best and function more efficiently.

The construction process was amazingly simple and quick.  We love our new pool and couldn't be happier with Gohlke Pools.  We have the added confidence that Gohlke Pools has been there and will continue to be there for us in the future.
reviews.author: Chris Toland

reviews.text:
Gohlke is "Hands Down the Best" !  The Craftsmen that they employ are true experts. Connor was very thoughtful and patient with us during the planning process and had some excellent ideas. The pool construction and equipment installation were all done in a timely manor and the crews were very accommodating to our schedules.
I would recommend this Long Time Denton Company to any of my Friends and Relatives !  Thanks Gohlke !

reviews.text: I purchased my Sundance Hot Tub from the great crew at Gohlke's a little over 2 years ago and I enjoy soaking away the aches and pains almost every evening and I also love having it regularly maintained by them so I always know that it is clean & balanced when I get in & especially when it is time to change out the water. Cindy just came and did a great job doing that and deep cleaned it thoroughly. Their service department has always been great also when I needed some minor service a couple of times.
reviews.author: Pam Grimes

reviews.text: We were having pool issues that made the pool turn green. Joe Tolbert came out and quickly diagnosed the low water flow rate issue. He made the adjustments and now everything is good. Thanks!
reviews.author: Jeannie Duffey

reviews.text: We have heard so many nightmares from our friends about them building their pool so we came into the process with a jaded view and very skeptical. When we selected Gohlke, we did it because we thought the team was honest, trustworthy and shot us straight. Our experience was incredible! From the beginning to the end, Wes and his team have been very upfront and worked with us to get us exactly what we wanted. We built a pool, an arbor and cemented a lot of our backyard and they were incredible with their time lines, quality and customer service. I could not be happier with the end product! I would highly recommend Gohlke and feel so fortunate they are who we decided to partner with. It was an incredible experience!
reviews.author: Randy Richardson

reviews.text:
It is my pleasure to write an unsolicited raving review for Gohlke. Each and every time I have needed their help, they have gone above and beyond.

My first encounter when we moved here was a free visit to assess my equals and try to explain my equipment.

Later I needed them to replace my auxiliary pump and PVC. They were on time and did an excellent job!

Most recently, I had the privilege of working with Nick & Zack ordering various parts for my old equipment. A couple parts weren’t quite right but they were diligent in making them correct. I cannot say enough about both of them! They are invaluable to Gohlke! But what is most important to me is their honesty to make sure everything was correctly.

In my last interaction, I took my pool sweep in for Samuel to repair. He did a wonderful job and is a hard worker and very respectful. But when we got it to my pool an unrelated issue to the sweep, but related item broke off in the wall. Gohlke true to their word sent someone out asap to repair the female coupling in the wall at no charge to me.

That’s what you call service, and it has also gained my trust in them! And that is also what has built my loyalty with them as well satisfied loyal customer!

There may or may not be competitors who have cheaper parts. I personally feel they are fairly priced. But what you will not find anywhere else is employees like Nick, Zack, Tim & Samuel who care about their customers and are focused on satisfying the customer and making sure everything else done correctly.
reviews.author: Dan Irwin

reviews.text: As first-time swimming pool owners, we had a lot of questions and were wanting service as we just moved into our home. We met with our Service Tech/Supervisor, Evan, who was patient, kind, and responsive to give us all that we needed to enjoy our pool.  He provided repair quotes (as well as maintenance tips) for a few items that needed attention. I highly recommend Gohlke Pools and very happy with their service.
reviews.author: Lyle Whitsett

reviews.text: They go above and beyond to make sure that our pool is running properly. Technicians, service guys, repairs, new construction, and the office staff are all super helpful and friendly.
reviews.author: Bryan Beck

reviews.text: Gohlke built our pool and has serviced it since it was built. They've done a great job with the basic maintenance and helping us keep on top of the day to day items. Recently our Polaris cleaner finally gave up the ghost (it was 10 years old). After shopping around Gohlke got us the best price on the NEW Polaris Quattro Sport model. This thing is a TANK! It's awesome. And their guy Joey did the install and tech Gary made sure it was optimized for our pool! Not only are they knowledgeable but they know how to explain it to you and are super helpful and friendly. Highly recommended from build to maintenance to repair to retail.
reviews.author: Jason Thornton

reviews.text: Gohlke Pools has always been my go-to for pool maintenance. Recently I had to have the pool restored and they were great. Brandon, Adrian, and Evan have been wonderful and they got the pool up and running in no time!
reviews.author: Anna Ramage

reviews.text: We are very happy with our Gohlke Pool.  Wes was excellent to work with in the design phase.  We made minor changes to the original design which we were pleased with.  Nathan was very informative during the construction of the pool and was responsive to questions from a first time pool owner.  Now that the warm weather is here we are enjoying the benefits of pool ownership.
reviews.author: Don Dober

reviews.text: Gohlke has done a lot of work for us over the last two decades.  We’ve mistakenly veered away from time to time trying to save a dollar or two.  We were reminded last week why we should never do that.  Evan, who was tasked with getting our pool up and running for summer, came over 3 days in a row and respectfully handled all of our questions and concerns.  Evan, like just about everyone at Gohlke Pools, are professional!!  Customers for life!
reviews.author: David McLaughlin

reviews.text: If you are looking for a quality builder for your pool, I would recommend Gohlke.  Being owned and run by family makes their custom-centric value.  The materials and equipment selections are also premium.  The team always made their effort and time to satisfy our needs and/or answer our questions. Our pool was built and completed on schedule.  The project was managed smoothly and professionally (Matt was the one!).  The quality of the build adds beauty to our design.  We are so happy with our build that we signed up their maintenance service too.  We are confident that the team will continue to take care of our needs as they always do.
reviews.author: Carolyn Zhang

reviews.text: Joe not only fixed our Sundance hot tub, he explained things and taught us about how to care for it while he worked..He was kind and courteous and fun to talk to. Highly recommend Gohlke!
reviews.author: Karen Monique Gregg

reviews.text:
We went in looking for a Hot Tub. Pablo was great!  We have been taking care of our pool ourselves and have begun to have some issues. I think we have found our pool company!  They are very helpful!!

Yes we did get a very nice hot tub. Thank you Pablo!  Quick delivery and and perfect install!  Just waiting for the water to heat up!!
reviews.author: Patti flowers

reviews.text: I manage my pool myself, and come to Gohlke to get free water tests, free guidance and the chemicals to keep my pool rolling, especially the NST Prime tablets. They have the best group there to help, including Brittany, Megan, Tanner, and Pablo. Go there!
reviews.author: Michael Madsen

reviews.text: Matt Gohlke. Gohlke Pools built my pool past summer. Started off on the wrong foot because the sales guy boasted they were one of the few companies that use all 1/2" rebar. Rebar is getting installed and not all the rebar was 1/2" and not installed per what was contract as he boasted about. There was also an area that didnt look secure. I have a ME degree but not a rebar guy so I asked, is this right? The rebar company owner shows up the next morning to inspect and agreed is was not right and fixed both concerns right away. Base material for the travertine deck was called out on the contract. A truck shows up with the wronge material, no project manager on site so I turned them way. I called the project manager and let him know I had a specific material called out on the contract he said he would make it right. I then went on a week long vacation when they installed the deck, had cameras on the job site, not very high resolution so couldn't see what materials were installed. I could see method of installation, they did not compact the dirt prior to installing the base which is industry standard, confirmed by 3 paving companies. They installed the base over clumps of dirt, trash and debris. Matt's reply to this was the dirt has been there for decades, my house was built in 2015 and the pool gets a little over 4ft from the house, regardless to ensure a stable paving job you start with a strong base. He pretty much said live with it, I asked for some kind of remedy, I asked for a warranty in writing and they agreed but never got one, I have a recording of him agreeing. I asked them to guarentee their work for 5 years, if there was movement greater that 1/2 they come fix it as I understand most paving jobs set on a dry base will have some movement. but shouldn't more more that 1/2" in 5 years. As I did more research into code and proper installation methods for inground pools I found for safety and cleanliness the deck is supposed to slope away from the pools edge, so rain doesn't wash dirt in and water doesn't puddle making it slippery and people fall in. The pool was installed 2" lower than it should have been. Being close to the house and next to an existing concrete patio there was no way to fix this. I also have 2 out of 3 deck drains that water just flows around. I have pictures of all of this for anyone who is thinking of using Golhke.  The deck was uneven so I asked them to fix it, the first couple of times they used a grinder to "level" it. The deck is dry set not mortared in place, all the paving companies I contacted said they should have lifted the travertine paver adjusted the top lay of sand and reset the paver. Now you can see where they used a grinder because it changed the finish. On top of all that they were supposed installed a safety fence but forgot. Typically they are installed in a 4"-6" concrete deck, this was discussed before we contacted and they said they would widen the pool "beam" that circles the entire pool on the half where the fence was going to be installed, that didnt happen. So they were planning on installing it just in the 1 1/2" stone just sitting on sand. They had the installer come out to install it, he started drilling and noticed there was no concrete and didnt feel comfortable. Golhke came out to install the 4" of concrete under a single paver, I explained to the laborer that a wide deck of concrete functions very differently than a 6" x 4" deep peice of concrete and it need to be closer to 8" to 12" deep to even get close to the same capacity.  He didnt listen or was told not to I should say and the fence was installed.
reviews.author: Travis Carter

reviews.text: The Texas freeze would have cost me tens of thousands of dollars! It did not...why? Gohlke Pools! Their guy Travis is a rock star, their main office must be filled with rock stars! They came a week before the freeze as my pump was misbehaving...they diagnosed it promptly, winterized my lines, and came back the week after the freeze with a new pump! On time, at the price quoted, and I am better with my pool than before!
reviews.author: tim mason

reviews.text: The weekly pool service has been great. I often get comments on how good the water looks. The chemicals stay well balanced. Taylor was very courteous letting us know when he was arriving and after he finished cleaning. Very friendly technicians we know we can trust.
reviews.author: John Cooper

reviews.text: We used Gohlke Pools to redo our pool and patio decking and we are very happy with the results. Eli walked us through the design and color choices and Bill, the project manager, went above and beyond to ensure each phase of the work was completed to our satisfaction and that we were happy with the results. We were truly impressed with how he went the extra mile for us. We highly recommend using Gohlke Pools.
reviews.author: Dianna Lawson

reviews.text: Great Jacuzzi Customer Service. The technician Joey did an awesome job! I totally recommend them as a Jacuzzi Customer Service.
reviews.author: Wladimir Meskelis

reviews.text: These guys have great service at the store. They found a light lens for me that's been discontinued saving me thousands of dollars in repairs and helped repair my vacuum and argued to get it done under warranty with the manufacturer.
reviews.author: Bryan Kahlig

reviews.text: I bought the hot tub and thought the fantastic service would stop there.I had a minor issue with one of the pumps. So I reached out to Carson, who sold the hot tub to us. And he relayed my issues to clara in the front office who called and scheduled an appointment for joey to come out and check it.  He called on his way. Said it was not necessary for me to be there, so I could stay at work. He took care of everything in the first 15-20 minutes. And everything is fantastic. I highly recommend this company as they will take care of you through the life of whatever you buy.
reviews.author: Craig Bourland

reviews.text: Evan and Kaelob, have done a great job keeping my pool clean. They are knowledgeable and professional.
reviews.author: Cody Donnelly

reviews.text: Meg was a great help at the retail store! I really appreciate the steps on getting the pool cleaned up.
reviews.author: Amy Rachui

reviews.text: Been with this company about a year and I love them! Especially Evan, his communication is always prompt and I feel he genuinely care about my pool. Iv had a few things go wrong this summer and he has been on it! I really appreciate him and Gohlke pool for being precessional and efficient. 10/10 would recommend!
reviews.author: Sabin Davis

reviews.text: Excellent customer service!  I called to schedule a service repair on my Sundance spa and Claire was able to work me in a timely manner.  Joey was able to troubleshoot my spa and had it working in no time.  It was also refreshing to have him explain everything he was doing and why.  I highly recommend this team!
reviews.author: Susan D Hermes

reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about our remodel with Golke. Eli got the ball rolling with selecting materials and colors with great selection to choose from. Ben and the crew were great to work with. I got a call every day with what was done and what was planned for the next day. The crews cleaned up after themselves, and were spot-on with their work. The estimate was point on with no unexpected expenses.
reviews.author: Kathy Heimerdinger

reviews.text:
Gohlke was excellent to work with.

They were the only company that actually followed up after 6 months of calling every pool company to get repairs done.

Eli was prompt in coming out to take pictures and talk to me to get information on what I needed repaired and getting the quote to me for approval.

The project manager Bill was great to work with on making sure everyone did the job to my satisfaction.

The quality of work they did was fantastic. I added a few extra things to the project scope after the initial quote and they were prompt in getting the change orders done and the work completed.

I also had the service team check my equipment for issues because I had been having issues with air in the system and they were very prompt and reasonably priced for finding the issue and replacing parts that needed to be replaced to resolve the problem.
reviews.author: Cameron Murphy

reviews.text: From estimate phase to finish, I received excellent service. Bill Arnett, contractor, stopped everyday or called with updates for each phase. Watching the entire process unfold, I always felt at ease. Thank you to all who was involved in this pool and decking renovation. I made the right decision!!
reviews.author: Maggie Reinhold

reviews.text: I want to give a shout out to Travis with Gohlke Pools for doing a great job! He has skills! We had him put in new electrical updated equipment for our pool/spa, I can’t wait to try it out! He was so nice, knowledgeable and just a great guy, and Thank you Geo for your help too! We are pleased customers! 😁
reviews.author: Yvette Prater

reviews.text: In 2014 Gohlke built, and now maintains my pool.  An example of how their service is above and beyond! Recent storm, when I was not home, security cameras revealed the wind blew over two porch chairs and the rain cover off grill.  As it was Gohlke's day to service the pool, I called Emily and she notified our pool tech Brandon Johnson.  After cleaning the pool Brandon picked up and installed the grill cover and set the chairs up! Thank you Emily and Brandon for over the top service!
reviews.author: Leon S

reviews.text: Gohlke was responsive with scheduling and Evan came out to help get control of the pool chemicals at our newly purchased house.  He was knowledgeable and very helpful with the chems (patiently answering lots of questions from this 1st time pool owner) and with identifying other issues that were causing our water to be cloudy.  I highly recommend the Gohlke team.
reviews.author: Mike Martin

reviews.text: We've had a couple of pool cleaning companies in the past and we had some little issues with them, so we switched to Gohlke after talking with one of their representatives, Gary Birmes. We decided to switch based on all the services they provide and reading their prior reviews. We've been having our pool cleaned weekly by Triston & Connor, who've been doing a phenomenal job; the pool & spa always look pristine, they're very good about communicating any changes or issues, and are VERY RELIABLE & RESPECTFUL. We were also assigned a person that oversees the equipment maintenance, Evan, who is always going above & beyond to make sure we have a hassle-free pool experience. Evan is our main point-of-contact and it is SO NICE to have someone to send a quick text to with any questions/concerns and know that it will be addressed & handled! We're 100% happy that we switched to Gohlke several months ago!
reviews.author: Haleigh Harrison

reviews.text: Gohlke has done great work at our house for the last few years. Their service techs are very communicative and will go over and above to help where they can. Jason has been our equipment tech and he’s always a straight shooter, never selling us more than what we need when we bought a house with aging equipment, even recommending to wait on replacing a filter until after the winter season instead of just selling us a new one because he could. Evan has been great at our pool cleanings, even installing a new Polaris we bought but hadn’t gotten to setting up yet
reviews.author: Tim Smith

reviews.text: Had a pool designed and installed. Gohlke may have not been the cheapest but the service was well worth the cost.  We were informed every step of the way. The result is amazing
reviews.author: Jeanne Denmark

reviews.text: Gohlke Pools did not build our pool and I wish they had.  Jason with Gohlke just spent an hour truly teaching me how our equipment works and how to get the best performance from the system the original pool builder installed.  He was very knowledgeable and professional and taught me more in 1 hour then the original builder could in 3 years.  I highly recommend them for any of your pool needs.
reviews.author: Deanna Emerson

reviews.text: As a first time pool owner, I really appreciate the services that Gohlke provides. Weekly service by trusted technicians like Diego, Natalie, Isaac, CJ, Brian, and Charlie helps us to be able to consistently enjoy the pool specifically and our back yard in general. I appreciate the regular communication from the technicians and the billing administrators. The supervisors that I’ve dealt with: Evan, Giovanni, and Dale are responsive, polite, attentive, and patient. The specialist technicians like Travis have helped with repairs and improvements. I knew from the first interaction - pool school with Joey - that we’d made the right choice in taking our realtor’s advice and signing up with Gohlke.
reviews.author: Victoria DeCuir

reviews.text: We have been very happy with Gohlke-everything from Gary troubleshooting plumbing issues to Evan restoring my pool and replacing broken pool components to the ladies in the shop diagnosing water quality and care.  Great company and service all around. Thank you
reviews.author: Rob Texas

reviews.text: Hands down this is the best pool company we've ever had! If I could give Joey 10 Stars I would! He is so incredibly knowledgeable, hardworking and kind! This team has really been here when we needed help with our swim spa.
reviews.author: Kim Reed

reviews.text: We went to Gohlke Pools to check out their hot tubs and Pablo helped us find one that was right for us.  He answered all our questions and stayed in communication with us through the whole process.  Set up and delivery was great and Pablo's in home "Spa School" was super helpful.   Thanks, Pablo and delivery crew!
reviews.author: T Prince

reviews.text:
Great service, both for cleaning and repair! We've turned to Gohlke many times when the pool got out of hand or crazy texas weather damaged the equipment. Fast, reliable, and priced fairly.

Travis has quickly and professionally solved a number of repair issues for us over the years. Taylor gets the pool balanced the *first* time and always leaves it sparkling clean. Cannot recommend these two enough!

reviews.text: Gohlke did an outstanding job of re-tiling and re-plastering my pool. Love the pebble stone. Absolutely beautiful! Eli was great during the sales portion - loved his recommendations - and Bill was both supportive and responsive during the work phase.

reviews.text: Travis came out today to check out our pool before the winter season.  He was wonderful and explained everything so we were able to make the best choices for us.  Professional and courteous - Thanks Travis!!
